title: events
description: Result of `stride events` — projected CTL/ATL/TSB on each event date (ADR 0010: the arithmetic consequences of the recorded open plan, never a proposed one). The projection folds Metrics.load_step forward from the last computed daily_load row; each open session with a structured target contributes the load its kind prices to (Metrics.projected_load, ADR 0019: power TSS, pace rTSS, heart-rate hrTSS, session-RPE load), and a session with no target or no input to price it contributes zero and is counted. baseline_known false = no computed history, every number is decay over zero. ftp_known false = no 60d best-20min power, so power targets contribute nothing.

days_away.description: Days until the event from the local today. Negative = the event has passed: ctl/atl/tsb then echo the CURRENT baseline, not a projection — daily_load holds the event-day reading.

sessions_projected.description: How many of those carried a target the projection could price — the sessions whose load the projection actually contains. The gap to planned_in_window is the projection's stated blindness; `stride project` names each unpriced session and why.
